basic_info.description: Rare Investment or Owner-User Opportunity in Prime Location. Situated in the heart of San Francisco's highly sought-after Inner Richmond neighborhood, 278 7th Avenue offers a unique opportunity to own a well-maintained 4-unit building built in 1978. Each spacious unit features 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom, bright bay windows in the living room, and updated double-pane windows for added comfort and efficiency.    The desirable Owner's Units (Unit 2 and 3) will be delivered vacant, offering flexibility for immediate occupancy or market-rate rental potential. The generous finished 6-car garage, also delivered vacant, adds tremendous value for owner-users or investors alike. The property includes a beautifully landscaped owner's large backyard, ideal outdoor space for playing and/or entertaining. Intercom system in each unit. Just steps from shopping and dining, Golden Gate Park, and excellent transit options  this is an exceptional property in a location that rarely comes available.
